settings.title: Settings & Prompts
settings.description:
Configure AI conversation agents, prompts, and settings.

*Note: Custom prompts provided as-is without warranty - placeholder for question must remain present.*

data.voice_path: Voice path (how Alexa hands over the question)
data.fallback_agent: Fallback AI agent (used during outage/high demand)
data.primary_timeout: Time limit for the primary agent (seconds)
data.announce_model: Announce model name at the end of answers
data.enable_direct_query: Enable direct one-sentence query (without intermediate prompt)
data.direct_query_prefixes: Trigger prefixes for direct query (comma-separated, e.g. 'smart question, ai')
data.enable_ha_context: Provide Smart Home context to AI (weather, time, presence)
data.custom_knowledge: House Wiki & Family Facts (custom knowledge for the AI)
data.enable_detailed_followup: Offer follow-up question for deeper explanations
data.followup_prompt: Follow-up question prompt text (e.g. 'Yes or No?')
data.notify_target: Target device for mobile push (e.g. notify.notify or phone)
data.mobile_confirmation: Spoken confirmation when sending to smartphone
data.late_text: Announcement when the answer takes too long
data.retry_prompt: Prompt when question was not understood
data.abort_prompt: Abort announcement after second failed attempt
data.prompt_short: AI prompt for short answer (as-is, must include [question])
data.prompt_detailed: AI prompt for detailed explanation (as-is, use placeholders [question] and [previous_answer])

data_description.voice_path: Community: the previous path via the Actionable Notifications skill. Own skill: your Alexa skill „Schlaufuchs“ calls Home Assistant directly and speaks the answer at once. Both: both paths are active at the same time.
data_description.primary_timeout: If the primary agent has not answered by then, the fallback agent starts in parallel and the first valid answer wins. 0 = fallback agent only on an error.
data_description.answer_budget: If no agent has answered by then, Alexa says the text for slow answers and the answer follows as a push message to your phone. 0 = no time budget.

skill.title: 🎙️ Own Alexa skill
skill.description: 📋 Open voice model and skill code with copy buttons (new tab, link valid for 30 minutes) Webhook active: {active} · Skill linked: {linked} Last question via the skill: {last_request} How to create the skill: in the Alexa developer console create a custom skill with “Alexa-hosted (Python)” in region EU (Ireland). Paste the voice model under *Build → JSON Editor*, save and start *Build*. Under *Code* replace the content of `lambda_function.py` with the skill code and press *Deploy*. Set *Test* to *Development*. The webhook is only active if the voice path under *Settings & prompts* is “Own skill” or “Both”. **The skill code contains your secret address. Do not share it.**

data.skill_keep_open: Keep the dialog open („Noch eine Frage?“)

data_description.invocation_name: Lower case letters and spaces only. After a change paste and build the voice model again.
data_description.reset_skill: Afterwards the skill code must be copied again, the old one stops working.
data_description.skill_keep_open: After each answer Alexa asks „Noch eine Frage?“ (another question?) and keeps listening. „Nein“ or „Stopp“ ends the dialog.

echos.title: Echo assignment
echos.description:
These are the Echos that already used the own skill ({count}), shown with the end of their Alexa device ID and the time of their last question. Pick the matching Echo for each. The AI then knows the room, and “send to phone” finds the last answer of exactly this Echo.

The easiest way is by voice: on each Echo say “Alexa, sag Schlaufuchs, du stehst in der Küche”. Without an assignment the default Echo is used.

claude.title: Claude bridge

data_description.claude_url: e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8765 – leave empty to turn the bridge off.
data_description.claude_token: The secret token of the bridge (~/.config/claude-alexa/token).
data_description.claude_echos: Only these Echos may send tasks to Claude.
data_description.claude_allow_app: Tasks from the Alexa app on the phone (voice or typed) go to Claude; the answer arrives as a push on the phone. Say once in the app: "Alexa, sag Schlaufuchs, das ist mein Handy".

error.no_public_url: Home Assistant has no public HTTPS address (e.g. Nabu Casa). Without it the skill cannot reach Home Assistant.
error.invalid_invocation: The invocation name may only contain lower case letters and spaces.
error.invalid_url: The address must start with http:// or https://.
error.token_required: The bridge accepts no tasks without a token.
error.no_local_url: Home Assistant has no local address. Set it under Settings → System → Network.
